name: hellotalk-workspace
description: HelloTalk Open-Core Platform (Angular v22 + NestJS + Supabase + Centrifugo + LiveKit)

scripts.lint: bash install-node.sh && npm run check:constitution && cd backend && eslint --ignore-pattern '*.md'
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.test: cd frontend && npm run test -- --watch=false && cd ../backend && npm run test
scripts.verify: npm run check:constitution && npm run build && cd backend && npm run verify
scripts.verify:node: node --version && npm --version && echo '✅ Node.js and npm verified'
scripts.prepare: if [ -d .git ]; then npx husky || true; fi
